search_scope: Free public sources for >=3 years of point-in-time market-cap ranks with effective/as-of and publication/availability timestamps; no paid APIs, keys, trials, or compute.

candidates.pagination: top/limit per snapshot; snapshots list endpoint paginates by date; no cursor token beyond date
candidates.missingness: Per-coin market_cap, rank, price, status, date_added, delisted_at present; no per-snapshot publication/availability timestamp (only retrieval as_of = query time); no hourly granularity (daily only); historical CMC-derived reconstruction, not original publication time
candidates.terms_limits: Free, no key/registration; <=60 req/min/IP; User-Agent with contact required; no reselling raw data; data derived from CoinMarketCap
candidates.gate_assessment: PARTIAL: >=3 years of daily effective/as-of market-cap ranks available for free without keys, but no per-snapshot publication/availability timestamp; point-in-time admissibility cannot be strictly verified (lookahead risk). Not sufficient alone to flip gate to PASS.

reason: No free public source found that provides both effective/as-of and publication/availability timestamps for >=3 years of historical market-cap ranks. CryptWatch provides the longest free daily history (~13.5y) but lacks per-snapshot publication timestamps; previously documented sources (CoinGecko 365d, CoinPaprika 1y, CMC paid, etc.) remain blocked. Gate stays BLOCKED; no empirical grid run; no performance metrics claimed.
